newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TALLINNA PANK SELLS SHIPPING LOAN - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TALLINNA PANK SELLS SHIPPING LOAN - REPORT.

text.p: Tallinna Pank, Estonia's fourth largest bank, sold its 42.1 million kroons shipping loan to Tallinvest, an investment firm, for 32 million kroons, the Aripaev business paper said on Monday.
The loan was originally given to TH Ferries which services the Tallinn-Helsinki line. The sale of the loan means a loss of 10 million kroons to the bank, the paper said.
Tallinvest must repay the loan by the end of 1997, the paper added.
"By taking this step we expect to end the groundless speculations on excessive financial risks taken by the bank," the bank board's statement was reported as saying.
